rs.key_step: 预算分配用全response entropy候选与path/node衰减，credit另用exact-prefix续写reward方差；去重prefix并切不重叠segments。
rs.why_non_obvious: uncertainty只筛可探索点，outcomevariance才决定调制；仍不是某个孤立动作的因果必要性。
rs.trigger_condition: When entropy-based branching conflates exploration with credit, allocate branches separately and estimate continuation sensitivity under exact prefixes.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When entropy-based branching conflates exploration with credit, allocate branches separately and estimate continuation sensitivity under exact prefixes.
